invariants.rationale: file is used in method calls early in the method, so it is expected to be non-null at entry.
file.extension() is called, so the result must be non-null for reasonable use.
file.path() is likely used as FileHandle represents a file, and reading its path is generally required.
file.exists() is a legal predicate (though always true or false), but using the method is valid at this program point.
file.isDirectory() can be called safely; this expresses that such properties are always computable.
